9254.text:
9254 * bījadhānya 'seed-corn'. [ bī́ja-, dhānyà -] Kho. bian 'rice sown and not transplanted'; Ku. binā m. pl. 'seed-corn, young plants sown in a bed for
transplantation'; Or. bihā̆na 'seed-corn'; Bi. bīhan 'seed', Mth. bihnāī ; H. behan m. (HŚS) 'seed-corn', f.
(Platts UD) 'nursery for rice-plants' = bīhan f. * bījadhānyavāṭī -.
